t.zh: 重建器让你能够改系数再回到图像。先从频率到零点的距离造增益，再把它接入完整的频率处理路径；不要把相位作为无关数据丢弃。 <wiki-ref to="frequency-filtering"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The synthesiser lets you modify coefficients and return to images. Construct gains from frequency distance, then connect the full filtering path while retaining phase information. <wiki-ref to="frequency-filtering"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: Cout[k] = g[k] C[k] g 是给定的频率增益：0 去掉该贡献，1 保留，介于两者之间则减弱。相同实数增益同时作用于实部和虚部；对实信号还须成对保留共轭关系。增益选择的是频率贡献，不是直接选择某几个像素。
after.en: Cout[k] = g[k] C[k] g is the supplied frequency gain: zero removes a contribution, one retains it and intermediate values attenuate it. The same real gain acts on both components. Real signals also require paired treatment of conjugate frequencies. Gains select frequency contributions, not individual pixels.

brief.zh: 频率表按未移中心顺序给出带符号的周期数。保留 |k|<cutoff，边界频率不保留。输出成对的低通增益，无需手算索引。
brief.en: Signed frequency indices are supplied in unshifted order. Keep |k|<cutoff, excluding the boundary, to produce paired low-pass gains without index calculations.

after.zh: g[k] = 1 if |k| < c; otherwise 0 k 是给定的带符号频率索引，c 是截止值。离零越近，变化越慢；用 |k| 能对正负频率采用同一标准。严格小于意味着截止边界本身不保留。
after.en: g[k] = 1 if |k| < c; otherwise 0 k is the supplied signed frequency index and c the cutoff. Frequencies nearer zero vary more slowly. |k| treats both signs alike, and the strict inequality excludes the cutoff boundary.

naiveWhy.zh: 只比较有符号大小会让所有负频率通过。实信号的正负频率必须按相同规则处理。
naiveWhy.en: Comparing signed values alone keeps all negative frequencies. Real-signal frequency pairs need matching rules.

hint.zh: 频率有正负，低通关心离零频率的距离。
hint.en: Frequency has a sign; low-pass depends on distance from zero.

brief.zh: 用给定增益同时调整每个系数的两分量，再重建。增益满足共轭配对；既要支持低通，也要支持去 DC 或带通。
brief.en: Apply supplied gains to both coefficient components before reconstruction. Gains preserve conjugate pairing; support low-pass, DC removal and band selection.

naiveWhy.zh: 只改实部会让同一频率的相位和幅度关系失衡，带相位的条纹尤其明显。
naiveWhy.en: Changing only the real component distorts the coefficient; phased stripes expose it.

hint.zh: 如果要删除一个频率，它的两路投影都不能留下。
hint.en: Removing a frequency requires removing both projection components.

desc.zh: 用自己的频谱仪、双分量增益与重建器处理每行。
desc.en: Filter rows using your analyser, paired component gains and synthesiser.
